messages:
maya: quick question — trying to run the Node SDK from inside a customer VPC that uses an outbound HTTP proxy + mTLS to our private control plane. I set REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://private-gw.company.local and HTTPS_PROXY, but streaming responses cut off after ~2-3 tokens. anyone seen this?

tj: which SDK version and runtime? node/py? also, is the proxy doing TLS termination or tunneling (CONNECT)?

maya: node, SDK v0.8.1 on node 18. proxy is an enterprise appliance that does TLS inspection (so it terminates and re-mtls to upstream). i tried passing proxy via env and via the SDK config, same result.

ash: pro tip — when a proxy terminates TLS it often buffers chunked responses. streaming needs passthrough or keep-alive sockets. try forcing an agent with keepAlive and avoid proxy rewriting the host header.

ash: short example that worked for a customer: 
```js
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, cert: fs.readFileSync(process.env.REDWOOD_CLIENT_CERT_PATH), key: fs.readFileSync(process.env.REDWOOD_CLIENT_KEY_PATH) });
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseUrl: process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL, agent, headers: { 'X-Redwood-Streaming': 'passthrough' } });
```

tj: add to that: when using an HTTP proxy for TLS you want tunneling (CONNECT). for many proxy agents that is `tunnel: true` or use a tunneling agent. otherwise the proxy will re-encode and buffer.

maya: ah — i was using a plain http-proxy agent. i'll switch to tunneling. any special env vars for mTLS certs with our SDK?

sophie: SDK supports either inline PEM env vars or path vars. prefer *_PATH in private installs. e.g. REDWOOD_CLIENT_CERT_PATH=/etc/redwood/client.crt and REDWOOD_CLIENT_KEY_PATH=/etc/redwood/client.key. SDK will prefer the _PATH variants.

maya: streaming header 'X-Redwood-Streaming' — is that documented? i couldn't find it in public docs.

devex-bot: internal doc (private): https://internal.redwood.dev/devex/vpc-streaming-proxy-notes — includes header/agent examples :thumbsup:

ash: also check gateway feature flag: if the gateway has proxy buffering on, it will still buffer. ops can set ALLOW_PROXY_BUFFERING=false on the gateway for passthrough. ops/infra needs to flip that for private installs.

maya: what about retry behavior? if the stream fails after a few tokens, should clients retry the whole call?

ash: short answer: only retry the initial connect. streaming responses are not idempotent. for chat we have resumable flows using turn ids but most streaming endpoints assume client will not retry mid-stream. implement small connect-retry backoff and surface an error to the app if stream cuts.

tj: extra gotcha: some proxies rewrite the Host header. ensure the proxy preserves host or set explicit Host header in the SDK request. we added a SDK flag to not rewrite Host in v0.8.x.

maya: thanks all — i'll try tunneling + keepAlive agent + CERT_PATH and loop back with results. will also open a tiny PR updating the Node quickstart with a tunneling example and mTLS env var guidance.

sophie: cheers — ping me and i can review the PR for private install docs.
